task.question: How many exoplanet candidates were reported by astronomers in April 2026?
task.evidence: 28 April – Astronomers using data from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite report 11,554 exoplanet candidates, including 10,091 new candidates, from a machine-learning-assisted search of 83.7 million stellar light curves. One candidate, TIC 183374187 b, is confirmed as a hot Jupiter.
